Zombie Disco Block Party @ Elizabeth Street Garden
events.description: Annual outdoor Halloween-season community block party on Elizabeth Street outside Elizabeth Street Garden with DJs, open dance floors, and costumes.

events.name: Brooklyn FAM: Festival of Arts & Music
events.description: Annual free family-friendly festival featuring live music and dance performances, interactive workshops, and public art celebrating diverse diasporic voices.

events.name: 53rd Annual Village Halloween Parade
events.description: NYC's iconic world-famous Halloween parade along 6th Avenue from Spring St to 16th St. Costumed participants join open marching.

events.name: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Balloon Inflation Event
events.venue: American Museum of Natural History (Upper West Side)
events.description: Watch giant character balloons come to life the afternoon before the parade around the Museum of Natural History (77th to 81st St).

events.name: 100th Annual Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
events.venue: Upper West Side to Herald Square (6th Ave)
events.description: The historic 100th anniversary of Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, stepping off at 77th & Central Park West down to 34th St.

events.name: Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony
events.description: Live musical performances and the ceremonial lighting of the world-famous Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree.

events.name: Times Square New Year's Eve Ball Drop & Celebration
events.description: The global New Year's Eve celebration featuring live star performances, commercial hourly countdowns, and the midnight crystal ball drop.

events.name: Lunar New Year Chinatown Firecracker Ceremony & Cultural Festival
events.description: Traditional firecrackers to ward off evil spirits, lion dance troupes, martial arts, and cultural performances welcoming the New Year.

events.name: 266th New York City St. Patrick's Day Parade
events.description: The world's oldest and largest civilian parade, marching up Fifth Avenue past St. Patrick's Cathedral with bands, bagpipes, and Irish societies.

events.name: Museum Mile Festival 2027
events.description: Fifth Avenue is closed to traffic for 28 blocks as 8 world-class museums (The Met, Guggenheim, Cooper Hewitt, El Museo, etc.) open free to the public.

events.name: 45th Annual Coney Island Mermaid Parade
events.description: The nation's largest art parade celebrating marine mythology and artistic self-expression on the historic Coney Island Boardwalk.

events.name: NYC Pride March 2027
events.description: The monumental annual civil rights march from 25th St down 5th Ave past the Stonewall National Monument to 16th St.
